title: Can I BEAT Once a Pawn a King?
summary: Let's-play of the Steam early-access chess roguelike "Once Upon a King": tutorial and first rooms with Pongement (the black king's pawn), angel blessings (Pull, Hop) bought with piece shards, a butcher selling pieces (army of up to 2), keys/chests, white enemy patrols, the missing black king plot. Not a chess variant to recreate.
rules: Video game, not playable here: pieces move like chess pieces on dungeon rooms; white enemies move first and show their next move (patrol) with an order number.
Each piece spends its move; end the turn when no moves are left; clear a room by capturing all white pieces or reaching the key/door.
Blessings (Pull: pull an enemy within 2 tiles one closer; Hop: jump one non-furniture tile) cost mana (50 per room, +10 per kill) and do not spend the move.
Butcher sells pieces (bishop, pawn...), army capped at 2 pieces in the tutorial; chests open with a key.
win_condition: Clear rooms / progress the roguelike (no chess win condition).
